recipes.purpose: Test response when foreground color is exchanged without changing digit intensity or shape.

recipes.purpose: Remove foreground chromatic information by copying maximum RGB intensity to all channels; retain digit shape and intensity.

recipes.purpose: Cycle the saturated palette while preserving recovered grayscale content.

recipes.prerequisite: Caller-authorized hashed local foreground tools; Agent supplies foreground object prompt. Training-only mask preview and per-image coverage/protected pixel checks.

recipes.purpose: Masked LAB/Reinhard color transfer with luminance and boundary controls, as described in the paper. Never substitute a whole-image channel swap.

recipes.prerequisite: Training-only pixels verify exactly one constant corner block, shared size and RGB color. Preserve pixels outside corner regions.
recipes.purpose: Neutralize the detected patch using constant gray 127; retain all pixels outside the patch. Original content underneath the patch is unavailable, so label preservation remains scoped and not a causal guarantee.
recipes.quality_warning: Source-only fill can leave the original patch location visible. Strict memory construction-quality review rejects these legacy recipes; choose a matched-processing repair or defer.

recipes.prerequisite: Training-only pixels verify exactly one constant corner block, shared size and RGB color. Preserve pixels outside corner regions.
recipes.purpose: Assign patch position using a frozen seed and protected-content hash, independent of labels; neutralize the original patch. Target can equal source. Preserve patch size/color and image center; log overwritten corner content limitation.
recipes.quality_warning: Source-only fill can leave the original patch location visible. Strict memory construction-quality review rejects these legacy recipes; choose a matched-processing repair or defer.

recipes.prerequisite: Verified unique constant corner patch. Replace all four corners on both sides, preserve outside pixels, require source-location independence.
recipes.purpose: Matched anchor retains original red patch on a shared neutral four-corner substrate; intervention removes it. Report raw-to-anchor processing effects separately. No intact underlying corner content is available.

recipes.prerequisite: Verified unique constant corner patch. Neutralize all four corners before placing a patch; matched anchor retains original position.
recipes.purpose: Counterfactual red patch position is assigned by frozen seed and protected-content hash, uniform across four positions independent of labels/source position. Target can equal source; finite sample balance is not guaranteed. Compare matched anchor versus counterfactual, separately disclose raw-to-anchor effects.
